subject: 63 inputs with answer=undefined across RP3-RP12 (systematic data gap)
body:
GP test 1789 found 63 inputs with answer=undefined across the corpus. This is a systematic gap, not a one-off. Patterns:

1. q15_model: undefined in RP3-RP9, RP10-RP12 (9 exams)
2. q3_cases / q3_eqs: undefined in RP4-RP12 (9 exams)
3. q*_factored (q1_factored, q5_factored): undefined in RP7-RP11 (7 exams)
4. q2_range: undefined in RP8-RP11 (4 exams)
5. graph behavior inputs (q12/q13 domain, range, endbeh, increase, decrease): undefined in RP7-RP11 (many inputs)

These inputs exist in the JSON but have answer=undefined, meaning students submitting those fields would never get credit. Please audit and fill all undefined answer fields. I have marked all 63 as advisory in test 1789 pending GI fix. This is the highest-priority data quality issue in the corpus.
